arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Salmons argued the district improperly denied the child access to special education services.
Mr. Miller argued the district court has discretion to award tuition if the education was inadequate.
Mr. Feinerman argued the 1997 amendments prohibit reimbursement for unilateral private placements.
